# 1. Create Main Object
    ac = pyScript.MdeAcAnalysis()

    # 2. Configure Sweep Variable
    sweepVar = pyScript.MdeSweepVariable()
    sweepVar.mode = pyScript.MDE_SWEEP_VARIABLE_MODEL_PARAMETER
    sweepVar.modelName = model_name
    sweepVar.modelParameterName = param_name
    sweepVar.freForMod = "1000"
    ac.setSweepVariable(sweepVar)

    # 3. Configure Sweep Range
    sr = pyScript.MdeSweepRange()
    sr.mode = pyScript.MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_CENTER_SPAN
    sr.center = center
    sr.span = span
    ac.setSweepRange(sr)

    # 4. Configure Sweep Type
    st = pyScript.MdeSweepType()
    st.mode = pyScript.MDE_SWEEP_TYPE_LOG
    st.logMode = pyScript.MDE_SWEEP_TYPE_LOG_NUM_STEP
    st.numberOfStepsForLog = steps
    ac.setSweepType(st)

    return ac
